cross_package_notes.note: Verified read-only boundary compatibility across all W4/W5 internal/models packages and downstream imageprep callers (internal/searchutil, internal/reranking): all exported signatures preserved intact, zero W4/W5 files modified, and TestCatalogMigrationBaseline passes unchanged under -race.

invariants_checked: ModelSpec, ModelCost, Capabilities, ExtraConfig key constants, and ParseModelType are pure value types and side-effect-free helpers with zero mutable global state.
ParseModelType maps chat/embedding/rerank/vlm/asr aliases deterministically without mutating inputs; zero legacy brand or host-path residues.
Non-streaming responses read via api.ReadResponseCapped (64 MiB cap) and SSE streams read via bounded api.NewSSEReader; incomplete streamed tool_use blocks are dropped before execution.
Inline data: base64 image payloads enforce a 20 MiB decoded ceiling before base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString allocates; remote image URLs require http/https with non-empty host.
URL() preserves Endpoint.Query across all BaseURL shapes, Chat/ChatStream tolerate nil context, and request-creation/transport errors redact URL userinfo and query-string secrets.

findings.summary: imageSourceFor decoded arbitrary-size data: base64 payloads without a pre-allocation byte ceiling, URL() dropped Endpoint.Query when Endpoint.URL was unset, Chat/ChatStream panicked on nil context, and NewRequest failures leaked URL userinfo/query secrets.

invariants_checked: Responses are bounded via Endpoint.PostJSONWithRetry (64 MiB cap), single-item fusion invariant (len == 1) is enforced for text and image requests, and returned vectors are checked via api.ValidateEmbeddingVectors.
Nil context is normalized safely and URL userinfo/query-parameter secrets are redacted from request-creation and transport errors.

findings.summary: post returned decoded float32 vectors without running api.ValidateEmbeddingVectors (permitting NaN/Inf values), did not normalize nil context, and leaked URL userinfo/query secrets on NewRequest failures.

invariants_checked: Responses are bounded via Endpoint.PostJSONWithRetry and re-indexed/validated via api.PlaceEmbeddings (out-of-range index, duplicate index, empty vector, dimension uniformity, NaN/Inf rejection).
Empty text/image slices short-circuit without issuing network POSTs, nil context is normalized, and URL userinfo/query secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: Embed and EmbedImages issued empty-contents HTTP POSTs on empty batches, did not normalize nil context, and leaked URL userinfo/query secrets on NewRequest failures.

invariants_checked: Model segment in batchEmbedContents URL is path-escaped after stripping optional models/ prefix so ?/#// characters cannot inject query parameters or traverse paths.
Query-string API keys (?key=...) and URL userinfo credentials are redacted across all request-creation, SSRF, and transport errors.
Empty text/image batches short-circuit without network calls, nil context is normalized, and responses are validated via api.PlaceEmbeddings.

findings.summary: url() interpolated Endpoint.Model into the URL path without url.PathEscape (allowing query/fragment/path injection), empty batches issued invalid HTTP POSTs, nil context was not normalized, and NewRequest/url.Error failures leaked ?key= and URL userinfo secrets.

invariants_checked: Non-streaming responses read via api.ReadResponseCapped and SSE streams read via bounded api.NewSSEReader; requestURL path-escapes Model after stripping optional models/ prefix.

imagePart restricts non-data fileData.fileUri references to http/https/gs schemes with non-empty host (preventing unresolved resource:///local:///file:// URIs from leaking onto the wire) and caps inline data: payloads at 20 MiB.
Chat/ChatStream normalize nil context and redact ?key= query secrets and URL userinfo across request-creation and transport errors.

findings.summary: requestURL interpolated unescaped Endpoint.Model into the URL path, imagePart forwarded unresolved resource:///local:///file:// URIs as fileData.fileUri and lacked a 20 MiB cap on data: payloads, Chat/ChatStream panicked on nil context, and NewRequest errors leaked ?key=/userinfo secrets.

invariants_checked: BuildRequestBody rejects empty audio and verifies MaxEncodedBytes against base64.StdEncoding.EncodedLen before allocating the base64 data URI string.
Responses are bounded via Endpoint.PostJSONWithRetry, non-finite/negative usage.seconds durations are sanitized to 0, nil context is normalized, and URL secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: BuildRequestBody base64-encoded req.Audio in full before checking MaxEncodedBytes and accepted empty audio payloads, while Transcribe did not guard nil context, non-finite usage.seconds, or URL secret leaks in NewRequest errors.

invariants_checked: Non-streaming responses read via api.ReadResponseCapped and SSE streams read via bounded api.NewSSEReader; dsmlFilter bounds unclosed <｜DSML｜ holdback buffers to 1 MiB.
Chat/ChatStream normalize nil context before WithLLMTimeout and redact URL userinfo/query secrets across request-creation and transport errors.

findings.summary: dsmlFilter.Feed buffered unclosed <｜DSML｜ stream output in memory without bound, Chat/ChatStream panicked on nil context, and NewRequest errors leaked URL userinfo/query secrets.

invariants_checked: Responses are bounded via Endpoint.PostJSONWithRetry and validated via api.PlaceEmbeddings (index range, duplicates, uniform dimensions, NaN/Inf rejection).
Empty text and image batches short-circuit cleanly across both input-array and messages wire formats, nil context is normalized, and URL secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: Embed (when TextAsMessages was false) and EmbedImages (object format) sent HTTP POSTs for empty slices instead of short-circuiting like postMessages, did not normalize nil context, and leaked URL secrets on NewRequest failures.

invariants_checked: Non-streaming and streaming incomplete responses (status == "incomplete") never report finish_reason == "tool_calls", even when incomplete_details is null or carries an unknown reason.
convertMessages extracts text from system messages carrying MultiContent parts, Chat/ChatStream normalize nil context, and URL secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: rawResponse.finishReason fell through to "tool_calls" on non-streaming status=="incomplete" responses when incomplete_details was nil or unrecognized (allowing truncated tool-call arguments to execute), convertMessages dropped MultiContent system instructions, Chat/ChatStream panicked on nil context, and NewRequest errors leaked URL secrets.

invariants_checked: url() defaults empty Settings.Path to /audio/transcriptions, and Transcribe enforces non-empty audio and Settings.MaxFileBytes before api.EncodeMultipart copies upload bytes.
Responses are bounded via PostMultipartWithRetry, negative/non-finite durations and segment timestamps are sanitized to 0, nil context is normalized, and URL secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: url() resolved to BaseURL root when Settings.Path was empty instead of /audio/transcriptions, Transcribe buffered multipart payloads before checking MaxFileBytes, accepted negative/non-finite durations, did not normalize nil context, and leaked URL secrets on NewRequest errors.

invariants_checked: Responses are bounded via Endpoint.PostJSON and validate non-nil data array, exact score count, in-bounds non-duplicate indexes, and finite (non-NaN/Inf) scores.
Empty document slices short-circuit without issuing TopN:0 HTTP POSTs, nil context is normalized, and URL userinfo/query secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: Rerank sent invalid TopN:0 HTTP POSTs on empty document slices, lacked explicit finite-score checks and nil-context normalization, and leaked URL secrets on NewRequest errors.

invariants_checked: Responses are bounded via Endpoint.PostJSON and validate exact rank count, in-bounds non-duplicate indexes, and non-nil finite scores.
Empty document slices short-circuit without issuing empty texts:[] HTTP POSTs, nil context is normalized, and URL userinfo/query secrets are redacted from errors.

findings.summary: Rerank issued HTTP POSTs on empty document slices, lacked finite-score guards and nil-context normalization, and leaked URL secrets on NewRequest errors.

invariants_checked: BaseURL is validated for http/https scheme, non-empty host, absence of userinfo/query/fragment, and secutils.ValidateURLForSSRF; empty BaseURL preserves the SDK's default endpoint.

Underlying vikingdb-go-sdk HTTP client is wrapped in cappedRoundTripper + cappedReadCloser enforcing api.MaxResponseBytes (64 MiB) on both Content-Length and chunked streams without retrying oversized responses.
Rerank normalizes nil context, short-circuits empty document slices without RPCs, rejects NaN/Inf scores, and redacts SecretKey and URL secrets from all returned errors.

findings.summary: New overwrote the SDK default endpoint when BaseURL was empty and skipped scheme/userinfo/SSRF validation when set; SDK responses were read via unbounded io.ReadAll without a 64 MiB cap; Rerank lacked nil-context and empty-batch guards, finite-score validation, and SecretKey/URL redaction on errors.

invariants_checked: Both resolved.BaseURL and endpoint.URL are SSRF-validated via validateASRBaseURL with URL userinfo/query secrets redacted in errors and [ASR] request logs.

protocolASR enforces vendor MaxFileBytes (or a 100 MiB fallback ceiling for generic endpoints) before multipart encoding, normalizes nil context in WithLanguage/languageFrom/Transcribe, and sanitizes non-finite/negative durations before Langfuse JSON reporting.
ConfigFromModel clones ExtraConfig and CustomHeaders maps so caller mutations never alias shared types.Model parameters.

findings.summary: WithLanguage/languageFrom panicked on nil context, ConfigFromModel aliased ExtraConfig and CustomHeaders maps, generic endpoints with MaxFileBytes==0 had no upload size ceiling, non-finite durations poisoned Langfuse JSON/integer conversion, and validateASRBaseURL/logs echoed unredacted URL secrets.

invariants_checked: Embedded catalog JSON files are parsed once via sync.Once with DisallowUnknownFields(), and New, Models, ModelsByType, and FindModel deep-copy entries via configcopy.Clone so callers cannot mutate catalog state.
Glob matching in matchPattern uses iterative two-pointer backtracking with zero exponential regex/recursion behavior and zero legacy brand residues.

Decompression bombs are blocked before image.Decode via maxImagePixels (40,000,000) and maxImageSide (32,768), and recognized formats with corrupt/truncated headers are rejected even on the pass-through path.
LimitsOf clones ImageMIMETypes slice so callers cannot mutate vendor settings.

findings.summary: Prepare ignored non-ErrFormat image.DecodeConfig errors on the fast pass-through path, forwarding truncated or corrupt PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/WebP headers to upstream vision/embedding endpoints when MIME and byte length matched.

invariants_checked: Clone deep-copies pointers, interfaces, slices, maps, and exported struct fields recursively while preserving scalar and unexported struct fields without reflect.Value.Set panics.

findings.summary: cloneValue called out.Field(i).Set(...) unconditionally on every struct field, panicking with reflect.Value.Set unaddressable/unexported error if any copied struct contained an unexported field.

invariants_checked: Both localLimiter and redisLimiter fail open on backend errors or context cancellation, release slots idempotently via sync.Once, and run race-free under concurrent limit updates and -race.

GateNamedN, RuntimeStats, localLimiter.Acquire, and redisLimiter.Acquire/RuntimeStats normalize nil context safely; redisLimiter guards non-positive ttl/pollInterval and bounds detached heartbeat/release Redis RPCs with 5s timeouts.

findings.summary: GateNamedN, RuntimeStats, localLimiter.Acquire, and redisLimiter.Acquire/RuntimeStats panicked on nil context, redisLimiter.hold panicked in time.NewTicker(l.ttl/3) when ttl < 3ns or busy-spun when pollInterval <= 0, and background lease refresh/release Redis calls used unbounded context.Background().

invariants_checked: All 34 vendor definitions register deterministic metadata, auth styles, endpoint hooks, and GenyeeCloud-compliant branding with zero legacy brand/prefix residues.
Definition receiver methods handle nil receivers without panicking, and CredentialLabelFor returns a deep-cloned CredentialLabel so callers cannot mutate registered provider definitions.

findings.summary: Definition methods (SupportsType, LocalizedName, LocalizedDescription, CredentialLabelFor, AuthStyleFor, ValidateConfig) panicked on nil receivers unlike GetDefaultURL, and CredentialLabelFor returned a pointer into the internal CredentialLabels slice.

invariants_checked: newReranker validates both resolved.BaseURL and endpoint.URL against SSRF with URL secrets redacted in errors and debug request previews.

protocolReranker.Rerank and RerankImages bound concurrency via errgroup.SetLimit, normalize nil context, and reject out-of-range, duplicate, or non-finite (NaN/Inf) scores before logistic scaling and sort.SliceStable.
ConfigFromModel clones ExtraConfig and CustomHeaders maps, and newVolcengineClient guards nil config/resolved and honors Rerank.RequestTimeout.

findings.summary: protocolReranker.Rerank and RerankImages panicked on nil context and accepted NaN/Inf scores (breaking sort.SliceStable weak ordering and poisoning Langfuse stats), newReranker skipped SSRF validation on endpoint.URL, ConfigFromModel aliased maps, newVolcengineClient dereferenced nil config/resolved, and debug/SSRF helpers echoed URL secrets.

invariants_checked: Resolve deep-copies Vendor, ThinkingLevels (*string pointers), Spec.Input, and Capabilities().Input so caller mutations never corrupt live Runtime provider generations under concurrent access.

loadOverlayIcon enforces relative-path confinement via EvalSymlinks, 256 KiB size cap, SVG root element check, and rejects XML <!ENTITY (XXE), <script>, <foreignObject>, javascript: URIs, and event-handler attributes.
DecodeCompat, upsertOverlayModel, and applyOverlayProvider reject trailing JSON tokens and non-object model_overrides.*.compat payloads while guarding nil Resolved/Provider receivers.

findings.summary: Resolve copied *string pointers from live uncloned vendor.ThinkingLevels without cloning (allowing callers to mutate shared registry state concurrently) and aliased Spec.Input in Capabilities(); loadOverlayIcon allowed SVG <!ENTITY (XXE) and <script>/onload/javascript: XSS payloads; DecodeCompat/upsertOverlayModel accepted trailing JSON tokens and applyPatch silently ignored malformed model_overrides.*.compat.

invariants_checked: ChunkSlice and MapSlice handle empty slices, non-positive chunkSize, overflow-safe slice preallocation (1 + (len-1)/chunkSize), and callback panic propagation cleanly.
NewVLM, NewRemoteAPIVLM, and NewOllamaVLM guard nil Config without panicking; ConfigFromModel clones CustomHeaders while preserving Spec pointer identity.

RemoteAPIVLM and OllamaVLM normalize nil context, enforce 20 MiB per-image and 64 MiB total-request byte caps plus 40M-pixel/32768-side decompression-bomb checks before base64 encoding, reject non-finite/negative temperature overrides, and redact URL secrets in validateVLMBaseURL.

findings.summary: NewVLM/NewRemoteAPIVLM/NewOllamaVLM panicked on nil config, PredictWithOptions panicked on nil context and lacked per-image/total byte caps and pixel-bomb dimension checks before base64 allocation, NewRemoteAPIVLM accepted NaN/Inf temperature strings, ConfigFromModel aliased CustomHeaders, and validateVLMBaseURL echoed URL secrets.
